'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 2 Kevin Shannon DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
